custom_nodes.title: MOSS BBOX Prompter
custom_nodes.description: Manual five-color BBOX layout and Character/Object/Text prompt export for MOSS-Image. Reuses the Krea2 BBOX Prompter UI and supports traditional ComfyUI. Requires Krea2 BBOX Prompter Suite to be installed. MIT licensed.
